sources.title: Diablo IV patch 1.3.0 notes (2024-01-23)
sources.quote: Helltide will now be active every hour on the hour, with a 5-minute gap in between. Helltide will be active 55 minutes of every hour.

phase.note: On the hour, in UTC (the same quote).

location.hint: shown in game when it begins
location.reason: Not predicted for this Helltide: the region cycle is pinned under the schedule in force, and a new schedule needs a new pin. The in-game map shows the region once it begins; a second Helltide can run in an expansion region at the same time. Select the region on the radar and mark it, and it shows until the Helltide ends.

announcedChanges.summary: Season 16: base-game zones start on the hour, expansion zones on the half hour. Live servers keep the hourly schedule until Season 16 starts (date not announced).

sources.title: The 3.3.0 PTR: What You Need to Know (2026-10-22)
sources.quote: Helltides now start on the hour for base game zones and on the 30 minute mark in expansion zones, so a Helltide is always at least active in non-expansion zones.

rotations.note: Blizzard documents no order for Helltide regions. Predicted from the Helltide region cycle.

sources.title: Diablo IV patch 1.2.0 notes (2023-10-17)
sources.quote: The time between World Boss spawns has been reduced from 6 hours to 3.5 hours.

phase.note: Blizzard does not publish when the cycle starts. Spawns fall where Unix time mod 12600 = 10800: the times every community tracker and open-source project checked on 2026-10-23 agree on. Not yet observed in game.

sources.title: Community trackers and open-source projects agree on these times (checked 2026-10-23); not used at runtime. How start times are checked

identity.hint: named in game before it spawns
identity.reason: Not predicted for this spawn: each pin of the World Boss rotation is used for a limited time, because the place in the order has shifted between weeks. The in-game map names the boss about an hour before the spawn; log it, and this card shows it and the rotation re-pins to it.

location.hint: shown in game before it spawns
location.reason: One of the fixed arenas, one per region (listed in each region's details on the radar). Which one a spawn uses is not predicted: no arena order holds. The in-game map shows it about an hour before the spawn.

roster.name: Ashava
roster.note: Seen in game as the World Boss on 2026-10-24.

roster.note: A world boss since launch; listed by every community tracker in 2026. No current Blizzard roster page.

sources.title: Vanquish the Lesser Evils in Season of Divine Intervention
sources.quote: Azmodan is now a permanent world boss across both Seasonal and Eternal realms.

rotations.note: Blizzard documents no boss order. Predicted from the World Boss rotation.
Blizzard documents no arena order, and none holds in tracker records: every boss is seen in every region. The arena is not predicted; the in-game map shows it about an hour before the spawn.

extraSpawn.note: Every fourth spawn brings a second World Boss in an expansion region (Nahantu, and perhaps Skovos) as well as the usual one. Not documented by Blizzard: every dated first-hand report of two at once, from October 2024 to September 2026, falls on these spawns (every 14 hours). Which bosses they are is not predictable.

sources.title: Blizzard forums, first-hand report (2024-10-29): Ashava at Caen Adar and The Cauldron at the same spawn
sources.quote: Ashava is spawning in Caen Adar and also in The Cauldron.

sources.title: Blizzard forums, first-hand report (2024-10-21): one World Boss in Hawezar, another in Nahantu
sources.quote: I have one world boss in Hawezar that will get me whispers, and the other in Nahantu

sources.title: Blizzard forums, first-hand report (2024-10-20)
sources.quote: world bosses always spawn in the base game, and every now and then, also in nahantu.

sources.title: Blizzard forums, first-hand report (2026-09-18): Wandering Death in Nahantu and a second World Boss at the same spawn
sources.quote: I think it was two World Boss spawns, the other one was in Desert or Steppes.

sources.title: Diablo IV patch 1.2.0 notes (2023-10-17)
sources.quote: The time between Legion Events has been reduced from 30 minutes to 25 minutes.

phase.note: Blizzard does not publish when the cycle starts. Starts fall where Unix time mod 1500 = 1200: the times every community tracker and open-source project checked on 2026-10-23 agree on. Not yet observed in game.

sources.title: Community trackers and open-source projects agree on these times (checked 2026-10-23); not used at runtime. How start times are checked

location.reason: Not predicted for this Legion: the site groups are pinned under the schedule in force, and a new schedule needs a new pin. The in-game map marks the site shortly before it starts; log it and the card shows it.

rotations.note: Blizzard documents no order for Legion sites. The group of four candidates is predicted; the site within it is not.
